label: 1. Hey there, friend! Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hey there, friend! Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Name's Raptilion.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'm a massive animal lover, and you'll always find me working on the surface.
Did you say you work on the surface?
So I take it you're a big fan of animals?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Right!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I haven't really been keeping the best track,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: but I'm pretty sure I've been up here for 3 or 4 years.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's the longest stretch of time any human has spent up on the surface

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: for the sake of sharing my findings with others!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's right!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It throws a lot of people off when they hear that,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: considering how most animals went extinct long ago.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: However, I believe that new animal variants have developed upon the surface.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: In order to get the word out,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I make radio broadcasts to the Ark whenever I have the chance.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: This is the first time one of my transmissions has been successful!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: On that note, I actually have a question I'd like to ask you.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: What's your opinion of Raptures?
I don't really have an opinion.
I despise them.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I see, so you haven't made up your mind yet.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I see, so you hold a lot of animosity against Raptures.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Well, after you see what I have to show you,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll have you singing praises of Raptures.
That's impossible

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hahaha, you mustn't be so small-minded, my friend!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Nothing is impossible in this world.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The only thing that separates us from Raptures

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: is our own prejudice.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Find me at these coordinates,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: if you're interested, even a little.
